Choosing chat SDK building blocks starts with what each product actually ships, because a vendor's SDK list says nothing about its UI components.

## What the vendors ship

Strong UI component libraries that meaningfully reduce integration time. Its UI kits are offered for customizability and speed of integration, plus UI kits that sit on top of the SDK for faster interface work.

## Why it pays back

Compounding effects over 18 months.
